% trimclip loaded alone with pdfTeX's driver option, after graphicx.
% Each box's text is the same as without the option, where trimclip uses
% its dvips driver.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage[pdftex]{trimclip}
\begin{document}
Clip: \clipbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{clipped text}. After the clip.

Trim: \trimbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{trimmed text}. After the trim.
\end{document}
